tweetMedia.transcription: And it looked like when they walked to change sides that maybe Alcaraz was thinking about retiring, Chris. What did you think from down there, courtside? I thought the same thing, Patrick. When that racket changed his hands and he's walking to the net, immediately my mind went to, it could be, he could be about to retire. But he immediately kind of pivoted left, turned left, changed his whole kind of stride. And you can see Zverev, he's been a bit confused there. Alcaraz gave Zverev a bit of an apology. wave because I think he understood that Zverev assumed that maybe the handshake was coming. So we're going to see if Alcaraz is able to turn this around. Zverev absolutely thought he was going to stop.
